items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. Ben Webster, George (inaudible), Rudy Powell, Pete Clark and everybody got the same mouthpiece, the same sound style.

ctx.x: bandstand and everybody had to get an 'A' (inaudible) and our rhythm section was a gas. Buster Harding, Buster Harding was the arranger, but we had two pianists. He played with Teddy.
Right. And Ben Webster was in that band?

Yeah. Ben Webster, George (inaudible), Rudy Powell, Pete Clark and everybody got the same mouthpiece, the same sound style. We played against Benny Goodman on a union gig, a union benefit there and we were on one side of the bandstand and Benny's got his band on the other side of the bandstand. We wiped out that band. Benny left his band and came over to us. J.C. and Teddy and me, he played with us and he left the band there and they hadn't played a note. (Laughter)
